CreateViewStmt.doc: Parsed CREATE VIEW statement. Covers `CREATE VIEW [IF NOT EXISTS] <name> [(<col_list>)] AS <select_stmt>`. The optional column-name list overrides the projection labels of the underlying SelectStmt. TEMP and schema-qualified names are deferred.

CreateViewParseOk.doc: Successful parse output: the CreateViewStmt plus the index of the next un-consumed token (typically `;` or `Eof`).

parse_create_view.doc: Parse a `CREATE VIEW` statement. Token at `start` must be `KwCreate`. Delegates to `parse_select` for the body. Rejects deferred forms (`TEMP`, schema-qualified names) with `deferred: <construct>`.
